name: Skyloom Stormsilk Filament
description: A conductive filament braided from stormdrawn silk.
specialEffects: Used in skyweave staves, charged bindings, and high-spire craft.

steps: Refine raw stock for Skyloom Stormsilk Filament under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Skyloom Refinery protocol before storage.
